node: Dry-type transformers, magnetics, and power-quality equipment
summary: Expanded the U.S.-listed universe around the transformer/power-quality chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. The cleanest pure-play dry-type transformer evidence in the provided search context is Hammond Power Solutions, but it is Canada-listed rather than a primary U.S.-listed common equity, so it is treated as context rather than a candidate. For U.S.-listed names, the best fits are adjacent engineered power-distribution, testing/diagnostics, electrical-pathway, and modular power providers. Powell Industries is the most visible reference name for custom engineered power distribution and data-center electrical systems. ESCO Technologies is an underfollowed testing/diagnostics gate through Doble and the pending Megger acquisition. Atkore is a second-order distributor/contractor-facing electrical infrastructure supplier. Pioneer Power Solutions is a micro-cap speculative shadow candidate tied to mobile/off-grid microgrid power rather than core transformer manufacturing.
